== Summary ==
Icon for [[Jeremy Bulloch]] ("Boba Fett") on the special guests schedule. Graphic: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999 website]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

== Source ==
* Shown on: [http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html DecipherCon 1999 special guests schedule], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000122135443/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Internet Archive]
* Image: [http://decipher.com/libraryimages/calendars/event/1999/mainevents/deciphercon/bobasm.gif bobasm.gif] (40×25). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000528040939/http://decipher.com/libraryimages/calendars/event/1999/mainevents/deciphercon/bobasm.gif Internet Archive]
* Identification: the schedule row it heads, "Jeremy Bullock [sic] Star Wars' Boba Fett".

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-3/33/Boba_Fett_DecipherCon_1999_guest_icon.gif Internet Archive item].
